QuestInfo.name: My dream is to...
QuestInfo.0: Blake has a dream...but he wants you to talk to him about it in a little bit, since he's in the middle of something.
QuestInfo.1: Is Blake's dream really achievable? Find #bLana#k, the head of Big Hit Records, while she's shopping in Kerning Square.
QuestInfo.2: Will Blake's dream ever come true?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 1,800\nCan proceed to the Lana's Decision quest\n

0.0: Hello, my name is Blake and I'm a public service worker in charge of Kerning Square's Lost and Found. Currently, my job is to find lost belongings and return them to their owners, but I have bigger and better things planned. Would you like to hear my dream?

yes.0: My dream is to become a famous singer and perform at the new concert hall in Kerning Square! I had an audition with Big Hit Records, and I just know the CEO will give me a chance to perform there one of these days. I'm on duty so could you, #b#h0##k, talk to #bLana#k of Big Hit Records and put in a good word? She's out shopping today.

1.0: Are you here to become a star? But your sense of style is all wrong. Tsk. \r\n#L0##b(How rude! If it weren't for Blake... Argh...) No, I am not here to be a star, ahem. I'm here for Blake, the public service worker at the subway station in Kerning Square.#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, right. Blake. That boy's got talent. \r\n#L0##bBlake says his dream is to perform in Kerning Square. Could you give him a chance?#l\n#k
1.2: Hm, I'll have to think about it. I'm not sure he's ready to make his debut just yet.

yes.0: Give me some time to think.

npc.0: You haven't talked to Lana, the CEO of Big Hit Records, yet? I'm sure you'll find her if you go up those stairs and enter the Shopping Center.
